section_summary.extract_value: This section presents confirmatory factor analyses (CFAs) of the BAS-2 instrument using Satorra-Bentler chi-square testing across three countries (Denmark, Portugal, Sweden) with separate analyses for girls and boys in each country. The results indicate that the unidimensional BAS-2 model fit the data well across all six gender-country subsamples (n = 79 Danish girls, 50 Danish boys, 296 Portuguese girls, 217 Portuguese boys, 155 Swedish girls, 215 Swedish boys; total N = 1012), with all item-factor loadings above .32 threshold.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents confirmatory factor analyses (CFAs) of the BAS-2 across three countries: Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden, with separate analyses for boys and girls in each country. The total sample comprised 1,012 participants (N = 1012; Danish girls n = 79, boys n = 50; Portuguese girls n = 296, boys n = 217; Swedish girls n = 155, boys n = 215). Table 3 displays standardized item-factor loadings for all 10 BAS-2 items, showing that the unidimensional model fit the data well across all groups, with most items loading above .60 on the latent factor.
